definition_zh: 弟兄们；同道；教友（brother 的古旧复数）
definition_en: the members of a group, especially a religious brotherhood; an old plural of brother
core_image: 一圈穿同色长袍的人围着长桌，互称弟兄
scene: 礼拜堂里，长老环视围坐的长桌，声音低沉而庄重。The preacher addressed his brethren in the small wooden chapel.
sceneCN: 这里 brethren 是「弟兄们、教友们」（第 1 个义项：同一信仰或团体的成员互称）；句意是传道人向小礼拜堂里的教友讲话。

pos.zh: 弟兄们；教友；同道（复数，正式或古旧用法）

derivatives.zh: 由 brother 加 -hood 构成，义为「兄弟情谊；团体」
由 brother 加 -ly 构成，义为「兄弟般的」
教友法庭，义为「教会内部审议机构」

senses.title: Members of a religious group
senses.definition: the male members of a religious community or church, addressed as brothers
senses.definitionCN: 宗教团体或教会的男性成员，彼此以弟兄相称
senses.example: The brethren gathered for evening prayer.
senses.exampleCN: 弟兄们聚在一起做晚祷。
senses.why: The old plural of brother survived inside churches, where members call one another brothers.
senses.whyCN: brother 的旧式复数在教会里保留下来，因为教友互称弟兄。

senses.title: Fellow members of a profession or group
senses.definition: people who share the same work, belief or society, treated like brothers
senses.definitionCN: 同一行业、信仰或社团中亲如手足的成员
senses.example: He wrote an open letter to his brethren at the bar.
senses.exampleCN: 他给律师界的同道写了一封公开信。
senses.why: The church usage spread to any group whose members feel like brothers.
senses.whyCN: 教会的用法扩散到一切「亲如弟兄」的群体。

senses.title: An archaic plural of brother
senses.definition: the older plural form of brother, kept by double plural marking -er plus -en
senses.definitionCN: brother 的古复数形式，由 brethre（brother 的古复数）再加复数后缀 -en 叠加而成
senses.example: Old texts wrote brethren where modern English writes brothers.
senses.exampleCN: 古文本写 brethren，现代英语写 brothers。
senses.why: English already had brethre as a plural, then added the -en plural again, doubling the mark.
senses.whyCN: 英语本有复数 brethre，又叠加了复数后缀 -en，形成双重复数标记。

intro.en: Brethren is a double plural built on the old form of brother.
intro.cn: brethren 是叠在 brother 古旧词形上的双重复数。

items.en: a reconstructed root bhrater meant the male sibling.
items.cn: 重构词根 bhrater 指男性同胞。

items.en: brothor named a brother; its plural was brothor or brethre.
items.cn: 古英语 brothor 指兄弟，复数为 brothor 或 brethre。

items.en: bretheren took the old plural brethre and added the -en plural ending.
items.cn: 中古英语 bretheren 在旧复数 brethre 上又加了 -en 复数词尾。

items.en: brothers rose as the regular plural; brethren narrowed to religious and formal use.
items.cn: brothers 成为规则复数，brethren 收窄为宗教与正式用语。

items.en: brethren now names church members and fellow members of a craft.
items.cn: 如今 brethren 指教友及某行当的同道。

note.en: Brethren sits next to its singular brother and to words for close male groups.
note.cn: brethren 与其单数 brother 及一组表示男性团体的词相邻。

entries.definition: a male sibling; the singular of brethren

entries.definitionCN: 如弟兄般的；由 brethren 派生的形容词

entries.definition: a short rest; a person who breathes
entries.definitionCN: 小憩；呼吸者——只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: plural of child with the same old -en plural ending
entries.definitionCN: child 的复数，与 brethren 同用古英语 -en 复数后缀

entries.definition: the regular modern plural of brother
the bond or organization of brothers
a group of men with shared aims; brotherhood

normalIntro.en: Link brethren to brother and to the -en plural of children.
normalIntro.cn: 把 brethren 与 brother 以及 children 的 -en 复数联系起来记。

normal.en: Brethren hides brethre plus -en, a doubled plural.
normal.cn: brethren 内含 brethre 加 -en，是双重复数。

normal.en: Children and brethren share the same old -en plural.
normal.cn: children 与 brethren 共用古英语 -en 复数词尾。

normal.en: Breth- echoes breath of brothers praying together.
normal.cn: breth- 呼应弟兄们一同祷告时的呼吸声。

normal.en: Churches kept the old plural long after brothers won.
normal.cn: brothers 胜出之后，教会仍保留这个旧复数。

normal.en: Brethren of the bar means fellow lawyers.
normal.cn: the brethren of the bar 指律师同行。

abstract.en: See a circle of robed men calling each other brother.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈穿长袍的人互称弟兄。

abstract.en: Hear one low voice say, my dear brethren.
abstract.cn: 听一个低沉的声音说：我亲爱的弟兄们。

abstract.en: Feel two old plural endings stacked like rings.
abstract.cn: 感觉两个古老的复数词尾像两枚戒指叠在一起。

examples.en: The brethren met every Sunday in the plain brick hall.
examples.cn: 教友们每周日在朴素的砖厅里聚会。

examples.en: He urged his brethren in the craft to defend the old standards.
examples.cn: 他敦促同行的同道们捍卫旧有标准。

examples.en: Old sermons opened with, dearly beloved brethren.
examples.cn: 旧式布道以「亲爱的教友们」开头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「布瑞镇」——弟兄们从同一个镇（镇＝brethren）里出来，彼此都是「布」衣兄弟。

root: brethren 由古英语 brother 的古复数 brethre 加复数后缀 -en 叠加而成，属「双重复数」；词根上溯至原始印欧语 bhrater（男性同胞），与拉丁语 frater、梵语 bhrātr̄ 同源。

sensesIntro.en: From the archaic plural of brother, the word settled into church address and then into fellow-membership.
sensesIntro.cn: 从 brother 的古复数出发，这个词固定为教会称呼，再扩展到一切同道群体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: robed men at one table calling each other brother.
core.cn: 核心意象：一群穿长袍的人围着一张桌子互称弟兄。

intro.en: Brethren is itself a suffixed form; its family adds further suffixes to brother.
intro.cn: brethren 本身就是加缀形式；其词族以 brother 为基再加后缀。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, cognate with Latin frater rather than borrowed from it.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语系，与拉丁语 frater 同源而非借自拉丁语。

items.meaningCN: 古英语复数后缀，如 children、oxen

items.structure: same root via Old French frere
items.meaning: a member of a mendicant order
items.example: a friar in a grey robe
